blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: inverted index — Maps terms to documents.
damping — Probability factor in random-surfer model.
out-degree — Number of directed outgoing links.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: A crawler discovers pages by following links and sitemaps; an index records useful information about documents for searching.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: PageRank models a random web surfer and passes importance through directed links. A link from a high-ranked page can carry more weight than one from a low-ranked page.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: PageRank uses damping and repeated iterations; raw incoming link counts alone are not the full algorithm. Search engines combine many ranking signals.
